description: This file contains implementation code for managing display modes and buffers using DRM, GBM, and related libraries on Raspberry Pi 4. It includes functions for device enumeration, connector and CRTC selection, buffer creation, and page flipping for display output.

classes.name: ModeSet
classes.description: Class managing DRM display mode setting, buffer creation, and page flipping on Raspberry Pi 4.

methods.name: ModeSet
methods.description: Constructor that initializes display mode, buffer, and device using DRM and GBM.

methods.name: Destruct
methods.description: Cleans up resources such as buffers, device, and file descriptors.

methods.name: Width
methods.description: Returns the width of the current buffer.

methods.name: Height
methods.description: Returns the height of the current buffer.

methods.name: CreateRenderTarget
methods.description: Creates a GBM surface for rendering with specified width and height.

methods.name: AddSurfaceToOutput
methods.description: Locks a buffer from the surface, creates a framebuffer, and returns its ID.

methods.name: DropSurfaceFromOutput
methods.description: Removes a framebuffer from DRM using its ID.

methods.name: ScanOutRenderTarget
methods.description: Performs page flip to display the buffer and handles event loop for synchronization.
